title: Conditional κ = 0.00300120 (71.9× smaller uniform-rank exponent)
body:
A new native frame contact changes the paid profile from `H2+H3` to `H1+H4` while retaining every independent helper output. The complete conditional transfer gives **κ = 0.00300120** and sufficient uniform rank **`2^2299850000000`**, reducing the exponent of #4441's sufficient rank by **71.88×**. At #4441's unchanged κ=0.00300105, the sufficient rank is **`2^249900000000`**, a **661.53×** exponent reduction. These are template bounds, not runtime speedups.

This builds on **my 0.0023 construction**, my higher-moment/logarithmic compiler work, Cinna Davis's query thinning and fresh-helper retiming (#4440/#4441), and Jacob Alan Sussman's mixed-target flow. The retained native, Clifford, BIT and outer sources keep their full contributor notices. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents. Apache-2.0.

### Construction and complete consumer

At phase B scalar contact 480, replace frame 732 by the three-dimensional span `[45,133,336]`, in both literal dual orientations. The four incident ranks change from `[2,2,1,3]` to `[1,1,2,4]`; strict concavity improves the paid moment for every `0<C<1`. Scalar order/coefficient, warp and center contacts, main endpoints and all 408 productive helpers remain fixed.

- Complete p17 word: 19 full calls, 16 individually paid query shears, 3,584 whole idle jobs, 11,560 productive fields, 69,273 paid requests and rank surplus 800.
- Exact raw-root bracket: `(0.0030012390170, 0.0030012390173)`; declared κ leaves explicit slack.
- Both completion and original-paid tails are charged at tested C=0.00300122, tensor power **675**, cutoff `18^675`, target floor `22^675` and higher-moment offset `3/25`.
- Logarithmic compiler contraction **15/16**, power **160**, with exact finite-rank inequalities and previous-grid controls.
- Retains ordinary BIT admission 0.0034 with atom 0.004; all nine outer rows, 54 current predicates, four guards and 63 legacy predicates pass.

Start at [the package README](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/kappa-native-lattice-submit/research/native-lattice-retiming/README.md), [proof](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/kappa-native-lattice-submit/research/native-lattice-retiming/PROOF.md), and [literature assessment](https://github.com/zxv/integer-mult-bounds/blob/codex/kappa-native-lattice-submit/research/native-lattice-retiming/LITERATURE.md). The optional line/hyperplane min-cut discovery reproduces the explicit contact; exact replay needs no optimizer.

### Concurrent work and source boundary

The submission refresh found **#4447** at `322e0ec764aa7ef7801383feb1f656e460dd8bed`, which reports the **same B/480 contact and paid profile** and declares the slightly higher κ=0.00300123. This contribution retains the reviewed κ=0.00300120 and supplies the smaller paid-tail and uniform-template bounds above, plus its separate discovery/replay path. **No unique-discovery or strongest-κ claim is made.**

Depends on unchanged pending **#4440** (`40e22a83ed660d3d6074c4f2dbf14bfb621eee51`) and **#4441** (`5f9d871c6bd1b9e34db5a7ea5ef08a908e94db39`), included in branch ancestry. New work is confined to `research/native-lattice-retiming/`; the source/provenance manifest resolves against the public #4441 head. Canonical main and priority guidance were refreshed before submission.

This is an **author-checked conditional construction awaiting independent scientific review**. Native/all-column, owned-erasure, whole-job matching, finite precision, analytic, physical tape, prime and exact-recovery contracts remain premises. The enormous product/uniform words are algorithmically specified, not materialized. No unconditional/formal theorem or selected-frontier change is claimed.

### Validation

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/native-lattice-retiming
```

- Registered replay passes: both native orientations, two interpreters, all 632 arbitrary persistent columns, owned-center erasure, and all four new edge types with absolute-phase decoding.
- Two exact moment engines, full invoice, both paid tails, compiler ranks and complete outer ledgers pass. Wrong-frame, phase-only, short-product and outer mutants reject.
- Git-free isolated optimized (`-I -O -B`) replay passes with exact receipt equality; changed-source and changed-receipt controls reject.
- Optional C++20 discovery reproduces the contact. Metadata/source pins and committed-byte checks pass on the submission branch.
- Full source-history preflight is unavailable in this shallow checkout; exact public source heads and consumed bytes are retained and pinned. No Lean, Docker, historical all-suite replay or hosted package pass is claimed here.
